verdict.rationale: Stripe Atlas is a web-based incorporation service, so opting out of analytics, usage tracking or cookies is a fair privacy question for it. The axis applies. No evidence in the pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics opt-out or privacy controls; the docs and community items cover incorporation, banking, taxes and support only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
